name: 3D Gaussian Data Layout
aliases: 3D Gaussian Data Layout — 3DGS Parameter Storage, Gaussian Struct Definition
definition: Defines the memory layout and fields for a 3D Gaussian primitive, storing position, scale, opacity, rotation, spherical harmonics coefficients, and precomputed 3D covariance.
summary: The 3D Gaussian Data Layout defines per-primitive fields like position and color using raw floating-point tensors for optimization, differing from packing methods that use compacted integer buffers.
